scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend-vue
scripts.start:backend:prod: npm run prisma:deploy -w backend && node backend/dist/prisma/seed.js && npm run start:prod -w backend
scripts.prisma:validate: node -e "process.env.DATABASE_URL ||= 'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5442/master_gateway?schema=public'; require('node:child_process').execSync('npx prisma validate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, shell: true });"
